description: OpenAlex type == dataset. Its own rule rather than part of non-article-type because it is the #149 decision and carries a standing obligation: the rows are ROUTED, not deleted — they stay in the survivor pool, are tagged with this rule id in `evaluations`, and a sampled audit of what this rule discards is owed before the milestone closes. Evidence from the 2026-08-03 pilot: dataset rows are 15-33% of every admission arm, and in the concept arm 69.8% of them proceed past the screen against 12.5% for articles — not because they are replications but because the screen cannot discard a row whose text it cannot read. Admitting them buys screen spend on unreadable records.

measured.rationale: An OpenAlex work typed `dataset` is a deposit record. The pilot measured the cost of NOT discarding: 69.8% proceed in the concept arm vs 12.5% for articles, an artifact of unreadable text rather than of replication content.
